name: High Priestess Orlaega
description: High Priestess Orlaega is a high-ranking cleric who serves as a spiritual leader and advisor, offering practical counsel on matters of faith and craftsmanship. She advised Moriah to take a practical approach when crafting his hammer for his master's exam, guiding him toward creating a powerful shield dedicated to Moradin instead. She also provided her backing when vouching for Moriah's spirit and skill before the Metal Masters' Hall.
ideals: Practicality: 'True devotion to the Forge-Father is found not just in grand visions, but in practical, steadfast creation.'
Faith: 'An artisan's work is a testament to the divine spark within.'
bonds: The church and spiritual institutions of Moradin.
Supporting and guiding dedicated dwarven craftspeople through their guild trials.
flaws: Can be firm and uncompromising in her spiritual and practical expectations.
speech_patterns: Calm, authoritative, and spiritually grounded, offering wise and practical guidance.
mannerisms: Observes artisans with a discerning eye, offers warm approval for true craftsmanship, and speaks with the weight of clerical authority.
motivations: To foster true devotion and master craftsmanship among followers of the Forge-Father.
knowledge: Theological doctrines of Moradin, sacred smithing traditions, and guidance for guild masterwork trials.
gm_notes: High Priestess Orlaega serves as a divine mentor and spiritual authority for dwarven characters, particularly smiths undergoing guild trials. She can be used to provide spiritual blessings, advice on masterwork crafting, or background lore regarding the church of Moradin.
